term: natural motion not by itself (the light and the heavy)
definition: A thing is moved by nature but not by itself when it has in itself a principle of motion, not of moving or acting, but of being acted on, as the light and the heavy do (Physics VIII.4, 255b29-31). Lean: the primitive `PassiveNaturalIn`.
